name: Osimertinib (EGFR-mutant NSCLC, first-line)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: EGFR-TKI gate: requires a sensitizing/activating EGFR mutation (exon 19 deletion or L858R). Osimertinib (third-generation EGFR TKI) is the preferred first-line option for advanced/metastatic EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R NSCLC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), NSCLC v7.2026, Therapy for Actionable Molecular Markers (EGFR Exon 19 Deletion or L858R Mutation).

histology: non-small cell lung cancer (predominantly adenocarcinoma; EGFR activating mutations are most common in nonsquamous histology)
supportiveCare: Continuous daily oral dosing until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
Monitor for QTc prolongation, interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis, and cardiomyopathy per labeling.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 or higher toxicity, ILD/pneumonitis, or QTc prolongation
doseModificationRules.text: Hold, reduce, or discontinue per labeling and clinical review; permanently discontinue for confirmed ILD/pneumonitis.

drugs.name: Osimertinib
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 70484 (FLAURA, osimertinib 80 mg per day). Osimertinib 80 mg PO once daily, continuous, until disease progression (represented here as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle, cycles null). The 80 mg once-daily dose is corroborated in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) NSCLC v7.2026 (line 4824, osimertinib 80 mg once daily).

provenance.locator: line 70484 (FLAURA: osimertinib 80 mg per day, first-line sensitizing EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC)
